name: Aiwo
source:
Aiwo is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
A green azure-eyed annor with pointy up-directed ears, typical for males, as well as with 8 thin long head spikes. A "skirt" has a pointy end on the chest.
A good planner and a pretty curious person, sticky to Remeelnie.
